gloss: to deceive, to trick, to cheat

definitions.explanation: To make someone believe something false.

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}に{騙|だま}された。
examples.english: I was tricked by a scammer.

notes:
{騙|だま}す implies intentional deception to gain advantage or cause harm.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: {人|ひと}を{騙|だま}す

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}を{騙|だま}す: to deceive someone
- {騙|だま}されないで: don't be fooled
- うまく{騙|だま}す: to trick cleverly
- {金|かね}を{騙|だま}し{取|と}る: to swindle money

PASSIVE FORM:
{騙|だま}される is very common, meaning "to be deceived" or "to fall for a trick."

RELATED:
- {詐欺|さぎ}: fraud, scam
- {嘘|うそ}をつく: to tell a lie (less malicious)
- {欺|あざむ}く: to deceive (literary)
